Under each section list items as '- scope: message'. Print the generated changelog.

python3 -c "
import re
import os

with open('/data/commits.log') as f:
    lines = [line.strip() for line in f if line.strip()]

features = []
fixes = []
others = []

pattern = re.compile(r'^([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)\(([^)]+)\):\s*(.+)$')

for line in lines:
    m = pattern.match(line)
    if not m:
        continue
    ctype, scope, msg = m.groups()
    entry = f'- {scope}: {msg}'
    if ctype == 'feat':
        features.append(entry)
    elif ctype == 'fix':
        fixes.append(entry)
    else:
        others.append(entry)

sections = []
if features:
    sections.append('## Features\n' + '\n'.join(features))
if fixes:
    sections.append('## Bug Fixes\n' + '\n'.join(fixes))
if others:
    sections.append('## Other\n' + '\n'.join(others))

content = '\n\n'.join(sections) + '\n'

os.makedirs('/release', exist_ok=True)
with open('/release/CHANGELOG.md', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print(content, end='')
"
